title: skill-packs.yaml
description: Skill packs with pack and skill on/off state. x-role marks app-input (passed to the app at startup) and app-state (set by the harness through the app API after startup).

schema_version.description: The schema version the file was written for.

skill_pack.description: A pack keyed by git_url. git_url, ref and enabled_by_default form its SKILL_PACKS entry.

git_url.description: The form the app stores: https, no trailing slash, ending in .git.

skills.description: Skills whose state the harness enforces. A skill not listed is not checked.

skill.description: A skill keyed by its name within the pack.
